snippet.title: Hire Help is Here! | Cure - A Hospital Simulator
snippet.description:
This update brings a whole new layer of control and chaos management to your ER with the introduction of Med-Hire, a brand-new in-game app that lets you recruit and manage staff like never before. Starting at hospital level 4, you can hire assistants to run reception and checkout, and guards to defend your ER from zombie threats at key entry points. Boost your team’s efficiency on demand with temporary performance upgrades, and add a personal touch to your hospital by renaming beds and treatment chairs—perfect for honoring friends, family, or even your favorite pets. 

Get it today for 25% off (for one week): https://store.steampowered.com/app/2786550/CURE__A_Hospital_Simulator/
